title: Let the Shabad pierce the false shelter
summary: The soul-bride is not made secure by polish or hiding; beauty begins when the Shabad breaks through the false self.
takeaway: Let the Shabad expose the shelter that cannot hold you.
lifeApplication: Before reaching for image, praise, or distraction, ask what part of the self is trying to stay hidden from the Beloved.

source.shortMeaning: False shelters and outer decoration collapse until love of the Beloved is pierced through by the Shabad.
source.lifeApplication: Notice the place you are decorating instead of surrendering, and bring that exact place under the Shabad.

evidence.coreClaim: False shelters and outer decoration collapse until love of the Beloved is pierced through by the Shabad.
evidence.turn: The shabad refuses cosmetic refuge and names Shabad-pierced love as the only beauty that stands at the Guru’s Gate.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before reaching for image, praise, or distraction, ask what part of the self is trying to stay hidden from the Beloved.
